title: Lunch Choices at Work
instructions: 这是为A2学习者设计的原创阅读材料（模拟练习，非官方雅思试题）。请先阅读短文，注意much/many/a little/a few和should/should not的用法。然后完成8道阅读题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。答案必须来自原文。
passage:
A. At my office, we have a small kitchen. Many people bring lunch from home. A few people buy food from the café next door. I am new here, so I watch and learn.

B. On Monday, I bring rice and chicken. I see Anna has a big salad. She says, "I eat many vegetables every day." Tom has a sandwich. He says, "I don't have much time, so I make a quick lunch." I have a little fruit, too.

C. On Tuesday, we talk about healthy food. Anna says, "You should eat a few nuts every day. They are good for you." Tom says, "You should not eat too much sugar. It is not good." I agree. I have a few cookies in my bag, but I don't eat them.

D. On Wednesday, we have a team lunch. The café has many choices. I want a little soup and a few dumplings. Anna wants a big salad again. Tom wants a sandwich, but he says, "I should not eat bread every day." He gets soup, too.

E. On Thursday, I bring a little rice and many vegetables. I feel good. I think, "I should eat like this every day." I also bring a few apples for my friends. They are happy.

F. On Friday, we have a party. There is a lot of food. I eat a little cake and a few chips. Tom eats much cake! Anna says, "Tom, you should not eat much cake." Tom laughs. "OK, OK. Next time, I eat a little." We all smile.

grammar.title: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not
grammar.explanation: much用于不可数名词（如time, sugar, cake），many用于可数名词复数（如vegetables, choices）。a little用于不可数名词，表示“一点”；a few用于可数名词复数，表示“几个”。should表示“应该”，should not表示“不应该”，后接动词原形。
grammar.example: You should eat a few nuts every day. You should not eat too much sugar.

questions.prompt: I don't have ___ time. I am busy.
questions.evidence: He says, "I don't have much time, so I make a quick lunch."
She says, "I eat many vegetables every day."

questions.prompt: I have ___ fruit in my bag. It is enough.
questions.explanation: fruit是不可数名词，表示“一点”用a little。
questions.evidence: I have a little fruit, too.

questions.prompt: There are ___ cookies on the table. You can take two.
questions.explanation: cookies是可数名词复数，表示“几个”用a few。
questions.evidence: I have a few cookies in my bag, but I don't eat them.

questions.prompt: You ___ eat too much sugar. It is not good.
questions.evidence: Tom says, "You should not eat too much sugar."

questions.prompt: You ___ eat a few nuts every day. They are good for you.
questions.evidence: Anna says, "You should eat a few nuts every day."

questions.prompt: There is ___ food at the party. We can eat a lot.
questions.evidence: There is a lot of food.

questions.prompt: I want ___ soup. I am not very hungry.
questions.explanation: soup是不可数名词，表示“一点”用a little。
questions.evidence: I want a little soup and a few dumplings.
